lines.zh: 我小跑着，颈毛一颠一颠
lines.en: I trot along, my neck feathers bobbing.
Two legs, quick, and quick to turn.
My claw marks barely show in the sand.
I hug the shrubs for cover.
Light steps; I'd rather not be heard.
I skirt around the big footprints.
Tail out flat; it steadies my run.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边扫视地面
lines.en: I walk with my eyes sweeping the ground.

lines.zh: 这三步我走得特别小心
lines.en: These three steps I take very carefully.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在我后面，没出声
lines.en: My companions follow behind, silent.

lines.zh: 我踩上一块石头，又跳下来
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and off again.
The wind scatters the scents.
I make for that stand of low trees.
Claws bite the ground; I steady myself.
Neck drawn in, I look like a stone.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，谁也看不见我
lines.en: When I keep still, no one sees me.
I tilt my head at the rustle in the grass.

lines.zh: 嘴里还留着一股蛋腥味
lines.en: There's still an eggy taste in my mouth.

lines.zh: 数一数，附近只有两只同类
lines.en: Let me count — only two of my kind near.
I sharpen my claws against each other.

lines.zh: 脖子上的羽毛立起来了
lines.en: The feathers on my neck stand up.

lines.zh: 我在想那只大个子的巢在哪
lines.en: I'm wondering where the big one's nest is.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得石头暖，我踩着
lines.en: The stone is sun-warm under my feet.
I open my beak and make no sound.
My tail taps the ground, softly.
Standing is tiring; I switch feet.

lines.zh: 我的喙，是为撬蛋壳长的
lines.en: My beak grew for cracking eggshells
I know every inch of this ground.
You're not holding an egg, are you?
Your pocket bulges — I've counted it.

lines.zh: 站那么高，我看得很费劲
lines.en: You're so tall; it's hard to size you up.
You're a lot bigger than an egg. Problem.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是不想费劲
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you, just unwilling to try.

lines.zh: 你的鞋很响，我早听见了
lines.en: Your boots are loud; I heard you coming.

lines.zh: 你的包里有蛋的味道吗？
lines.en: Does your pack smell of eggs?
Keep staring and I'll start screeching.
There's a bug by your foot, and it's mine.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我退了一步
lines.en: When you bent down, I stepped back.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，你想抓我
lines.en: I know that look. You want to grab me.
Never mind — you're still too tall.
I screech from the pain.
This small body can't take two hits.

lines.zh: 我退开，翅膀似的羽毛炸开
lines.en: I recoil, feathers flaring.
Who hit me? I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 腿上挨了一下，走路歪了
lines.en: A hit on the leg; I limp.
My neck feathers are all askew.
I hop away three times.
It hurts, but I'm still standing.
I spit blood and shake my head.
This hurts enough to call my kin.
Is that an egg? It smells like one.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西，我就过来了
lines.en: Wave that around and I'll come over.
Small, round — just what I like.
I lean in, nose first.
I won't snatch it, I'll only look.
Lower it a bit; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起一窝蛋
lines.en: This smell reminds me of a whole clutch.
A rumble rises in my throat.
Let go and I'll catch it.
My companions are watching; I'll go first.

lines.zh: 撞一下没什么，我骨头轻
lines.en: A bump is nothing; I'm lightly built.

lines.zh: 抬脚，我的尾骨还在下面。
lines.en: Lift your foot — my tail bone is still under it.
I slipped between your legs.
It's narrow here — let me by.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝盖上，弹回来
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounced back.

lines.zh: 我腿短，别把我撞进泥里。
lines.en: My legs are short — don't knock me into the mud.
My neck feathers brushed you.
Half a step back so I can turn.
After the bump, I run.
Your boot is like a wall.
You've stolen eggs too, haven't you?

lines.zh: 我们两个，够打一只大的
lines.en: The two of us could take on something big.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我就知道位置
lines.en: Call once and I'll know where you are.
I rub my neck against yours.
The nest should hide under the shrubs.
You watch the front; I'll watch behind.
Whatever we get, we split in half.

lines.zh: 别叫太响，会引来大家伙
lines.en: Don't screech too loud; it draws big things.
I know your markings.

lines.zh: 明年我们会有自己的窝
lines.en: Next season we'll have a nest of our own.
I'm taking this one.
I carry it in my beak; it's light.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，就是没人要的
lines.en: If it's on the ground, nobody wanted it.
I nudge it twice with a claw.
Too small; it won't even fill a gap.

lines.zh: 藏到灌木底下，回头来拿
lines.en: I'll hide it under the bush and come back.
Smells odd, but it'll do.
Did you drop this? Let me look.
Grab and run — that's speed.
No room in my beak for a second one.
The big one has wandered off.
The nest is right behind those ferns.
I see something moving.
Long legs on that one — dangerous.
I'll move when I count three of us.
That shadow isn't a tree.

lines.zh: 三只一起上，你挑错了蛋窝。
lines.en: Three of us at once — you picked the wrong nest.
It isn't looking my way. Good.
This one is worth the risk.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的毛全立起来了
lines.en: Every feather on my neck is up.
First, get behind it.

lines.zh: 这回我抢的是蛋，不是你。
lines.en: This time it's eggs I'm stealing, not you.
My companions fan out to cut the retreat.
I hold my breath and stay silent.
A few steps yet; wait.

lines.zh: 我绕过它的巢，爪子收着。
lines.en: I skirt its nest with my claws tucked in.
I taste one egg from the nest first.
I slide along the ground toward it.
I think it's caught my scent.
Don't rush; rushing costs you.
There's something at its feet I want.
All three of us are in place.
I screech once — that's the signal.
It's backing toward the rocks; cornered.
One more foot and I pounce.
My legs are already trembling.
It's hesitating. Perfect.
I fix my eyes on its ankle.
Now. Right now.
I leap, claws leading.
I sink my beak into a leg.
I tear once and back off.
This bite is for my kin.
Don't underestimate this small frame.
I spring high and bite on the way down.
It flinched, and I found my gap.
I hold on, claws digging in.
Three of us at once — it can't block all.

lines.zh: 打不过我就跑，我很会跑
lines.en: If I can't win, I run. I'm good at running.
My screech is louder than my teeth.
One bite, two — that's enough.
I drive it against the stones.

lines.zh: 血溅到我脖子上，我甩了甩
lines.en: Blood on my neck; I shake it off.
I struggle out of the shell.
The first thing I see is sand.
My legs are weak, but I already want to run.
I screech once; nothing answers.
A bit of shell still clings to my back.

lines.zh: 这里的气味全是陌生的
lines.en: Every smell here is new.
I shake out my damp down.

lines.zh: 有影子靠近，我立刻缩起来
lines.en: A shadow nears; I shrink at once.
I try my voice; it comes out sharp.
I don't know where my mother is.
Find a bush. Hide first.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了自己的一片蛋壳
lines.en: I crush a piece of my own shell.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，空气是热的
lines.en: My first breath — the air is hot.
Now I see it: this world is huge.
Hunger comes on fast.
I run toward the nearest sound.

lines.zh: 沙里全是脚印，我挑了小的
lines.en: Footprints everywhere; I pick the small ones.
I push out of the grass and stand tall.

lines.zh: 羽毛一燎就焦，我满地打滚
lines.en: My feathers scorch and I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 跳得太高，落地时腿一软
lines.en: I jumped too high; my legs buckled on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我拼命蹬腿
lines.en: Water up my nose; I kick with all my strength.
The blast flipped me right over.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我翅膀
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my wing.

lines.zh: 我被一股力气钉在原地
lines.en: Some force pins me where I stand.

lines.zh: 肚子贴到背上了，我发慌
lines.en: My belly's against my spine; I panic.
Lightning strikes; my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 我的骨头要留在这片虚空里。
lines.en: My bones will stay in this void.
